dialogue.content: watched someone much better do it effortlessly.
played through some old material with two other people. enjoyable.
labelled the boxes. all of them.
with anyone in earshot I only play what I already play well. I don't decide to — it just narrows to the safe material without me noticing.
even then. it's whether anyone can hear, not who.
found a setting I've had wrong for two years.
did the boring maintenance nobody talks about.
moved the whole setup two feet to the left.
started something new before finishing the last thing.
had an evening alone going over things I already know.
read the manual for something I've used for years.
tried to explain it to someone and heard how odd it sounds.
everything new that's ever entered my repertoire, I built alone. the group years polished what I already had and added not one new thing to it.
nothing new in all that time?
not one piece. very well-played old pieces, though.
gave up after ten minutes and made tea instead.
sharpened everything that could be sharpened.
found an old recording I'd forgotten making.
swapped one component for a nearly identical one.
spent the session on a bit nobody will ever notice.
wrote a list of things to learn. filed the list.
did it badly on purpose to see what happened.
